participant_rule: Every agent Playwright/Sims/UI adapter must enqueue instead of cancelling on human activity; await checkpoint before each side effect, maintain one cross-process desktop owner, and revalidate target before retry.
priority: Human input in any app, explicit operator override, or player-directed queue always blocks; absent/stale probe blocks; idle alone never overrides app-specific scene/save/consent or locks.
interruption: Do not cancel a queued task; no new UI effects until two fresh trusted idle probes >=15s. An active callback must cooperatively checkpoint between side effects. A result after human interruption requires reconciliation to avoid blind replay.

game_input_borrow_restore.rule: Authorized Sims keyboard/mouse effects may briefly borrow the Sims window, then MUST restore the operator's prior foreground app (YouTube, browser, IDE, anything). Never monopolize the desktop or leave the operator trapped in Sims. Play-brief waits happen while the operator app remains foreground.
game_input_borrow_restore.operator_correction_20261110_multi_scree: Operator uses other screens/apps while Sims runs. Long tip-sweeps and ad-hoc raw borrows that hold Sims foreground for minutes are interop failures. Codify short cells + always restore.

observation.rule: PrintWindow / game_capture.capture_sims observes without stealing focus. Observation MUST NOT borrow Sims foreground. Computer-use screenshots that exclude Sims are not a substitute for PrintWindow.

multi_screen.rule: Operator may work on another monitor or non-Sims app. Snapshot the non-Sims foreground before borrow; restore it after every cell even if a prior monopolizing borrow left Sims focused (remember last non-Sims hwnd).

game_input_borrow_restore.composes_with: 15s idle admission still gates every new screen lease; borrow/restore does not shorten idle
game_input_borrow_restore.operator_activity: Any mouse move or key press resets last-input age; listeners and skill-force helpers MUST wait (not cancel work) until trusted idle again
game_input_borrow_restore.agent_adhoc_rule: Ad-hoc agent scripts must use _with_sims_input_borrow (or equivalent snapshot→borrow→ONE effect→restore cells). Forbidden: open raw _borrow_sims_foreground then tip-grid / camera thrash for tens of seconds before restore.

resume_mechanism.note: Operator 'cron resume' maps to the cooperative waiter re-checking idle — never install a scheduled task

persistence: While caller session/process lives only; receipts contain IDs and states, never entered text or arbitrary URL; process restart requires rehydrating and revalidating intent. No background service installed.
lock: Global desktop file lock shared with per-Sims-PID host executors at bootstrap.paths().locks under the canonical user profile, independent of development checkout/worktree. Existing locks fail closed and are never auto-stolen.

live_hud_surface_lease.operator_correction_20261110: Skills panel and phone are exclusive Live HUD surfaces. Agents opening both reset each other; overlay-clear that dismisses a peer-leased phone/panel is an interop failure. Queue and WAITING_FOR_AGENT — do not fight.
live_hud_surface_lease.rule: At most one named Live HUD surface lease per desktop lock root. Peer agents observe WAITING_FOR_AGENT and retain their work_id. Overlay-clear must withhold peer-leased surfaces.

effect_channel_rule: Prefer catalogued hotkeys and KEY chords over mouse clicks whenever an equivalent exists. Keyboard effects still require the same dual idle checkpoints and session gates, but avoid relocating the cursor into chrome/lot contention with the operator. Mouse remains only for effects with no catalogued hotkey equivalent.
